title: Piku's brother, the Creole singer who played kazoo
summary: Nelson plays kazoo and two guitars on many jobs with Piku's brother, who made up his own Creole songs and played only the kazoo.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: did you ever know Piku's brother? I never got to meet him the one who would sing all the creole songs yeah what was his name?
oh I would call him Piku
I forget now his first name
was it a french name? I would call him Piku used to play the kazoot
yeah the same all the time
you ever played any jobs with him?
oh yeah many times many of them was always together I was with the kazoot and two guitars that old man named Jose Harris used to have him on days
did Mr. Piku's brother play any other instrument besides the kazoo? no never played guitar or anything?
did he make up all of these songs himself?
yeah he used to make up that
I heard he knew a lot of creole songs
yeah he used to make them up himself he used to play at the Rudy Doody there we'd have a gang of guitar players slow drag was our bass player there
